name: wordcraft-bridge
description: Write, edit (find/replace, comments, tracked changes), mail-merge, convert and preview documents with the WordCraft word processor installed on Windows, macOS or Linux. Not affiliated with WordCraft or Storytold.

wordcraft_dir.title: WordCraft folder
wordcraft_dir.description: Install folder of WordCraft (or WordCraft.app on macOS). Leave empty to auto-detect: C:\Program Files\WordCraft, /Applications/WordCraft.app, /usr/bin, /opt/wordcraft or PATH.

wordcraft_cli.title: wordcraft-cli executable (optional)
wordcraft_cli.description: Only if it is somewhere else, e.g. where you unzipped the wordcraft-cli zip on macOS.

control_port.title: WordCraft control port (optional)
control_port.description: Port used to drive the WordCraft app (open_in_wordcraft, run_wordcraft_commands live). Default 7985.
